# Reviewed Identity SDK artifacts

These are the immutable contracts 0.1.4 and renderer 0.2.5 archives. Their
SHA-512 digests exactly match the published GitHub Packages releases, recorded
with upstream URLs in iov-identity-release.json. The package source and metadata
are unchanged. Spec remains the sole publisher; these are the unchanged build inputs carried by the source branch.

Routine installs require no registry credential for these two dependencies.
Replace artifacts only as part of a coordinated release, never by editing an
archive in place. The release guard checks their digests, dependency/lock pins,
installed package versions and the shared compatibility manifest.
